national_news.title: Calcutta HC Cancels OBC Certificates Issued Under Revised Rules by Previous State Govt
bullets: Calcutta High Court cancels OBC certificates issued under OBC-A and OBC-B classifications introduced by the previous Trinamool Congress government in West Bengal.
Holders of these certificates will now be treated as belonging to the general category.
The controversy dates back to 2010, when the state divided OBC communities into two classifications.

national_news.title: IMD forecasts extremely heavy rainfall in Odisha and Gangetic West Bengal today
bullets: IMD issued a red colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Gangetic West Bengal and Odisha.
Places over Chhattisgarh are expected to experience heavy to very heavy rainfall till tomorrow.
Heavy rainfall is expected to prevail over several states including Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, and East Uttar Pradesh.

national_news.title: Parliament passes bill to enhance funding and development of cooperative sector
bullets: The National Co-operative Development Corporation (NCDC) (Amendment) Bill, 2026 has been passed by Parliament.
The Bill aims to further amend the National Co-operative Development Corporation Act, 1962.
The legislation allows the Corporation to undertake activities in industrial goods and provide loans and grants directly to co-operatives.

national_news.title: India to host Afghanistan for a three-match T20 International series in September
bullets: The series will be played at the Arun Jaitley Cricket Stadium in Delhi from 13 to 17 September.
The series is part of Afghanistan's Future Tours Program and will provide opportunities to Afghan players.
BCCI remains committed to supporting the growth of cricket in Afghanistan.

national_news.title: Thailand: Education Ministry plans to elevate schools' safety after fatal shooting
bullets: Thailand's cabinet has approved an Education Ministry's proposal to elevate school safety to a national agenda.
The move aims to strengthen prevention and response at educational institutions systematically, protecting children, teachers, and education personnel nationwide.
All schools have been designated School Safety Zones and must set up centres for the protection of rights, liberties, and safety on their premises.

national_news.title: India wins 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze in Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India secured 29 medals in total, including 8 Gold, 7 Silver, and 14 Bronze.
The Indian fencing team dominated the Senior Women's Foil category, winning gold and silver medals.
Kanaglakshmi and Joys Ashitha were the winners of the gold and silver medals respectively in the Senior Women's Foil category.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry suspends TTFI's recognition till restoration of its governance structure
bullets: The Sports Ministry suspended the recognition of the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI) due to governance deficiencies.
The Ministry cited TTFI's failure to conduct elections on time as one of the reasons for the suspension.
An ad-hoc committee will be formed by the Indian Olympic Association to administer the sport.

national_news.title: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa defeats Javokhir Sindarov in Sinquefield Cup
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa won his first match in the Sinquefield Cup.
The match was a part of the Grand Chess Tour, a prestigious international chess tournament.
Praggnanandhaa dominated the game from start to finish, ultimately defeating Javokhir Sindarov.

national_news.title: BRICS economies are major growth engines of global economy, says FM Sitharaman
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman emphasized the importance of public capital in catalyzing private investment.
BRICS economies are major growth engines of the global economy but face challenges in attracting private capital.
Sitharaman highlighted the need to build investor confidence, maintain stability, and provide a predictable environment.

national_news.title: India's retail inflation rises to 4.45%, remains above RBI's target of 4%
bullets: Retail inflation accelerated to 4.45% on an annual basis in July.
Inflation remained above the Reserve Bank of India's target of 4% for the second consecutive month.
Food prices remained elevated, contributing to the higher inflation reading.

national_news.title: Financial Inclusion in India: Banking Every Citizen, Empowering Every Household
bullets: India has expanded access to banking, digital payments, credit, insurance, pensions, and investment opportunities over the past decade.
The country has moved beyond universal bank account ownership towards active participation in the formal financial system.
This transformation has empowered millions of households, entrepreneurs, and businesses.

national_news.title: India's Infrastructure Transformation: From Connectivity to Capacity
bullets: Public capital expenditure has risen from about ₹2 lakh crore in FY 2014–15 to ₹12.2 lakh crore in FY
Infrastructure development has moved towards integrated planning and large-scale expansion, strengthening connectivity and improving access to essential services
This transformation has created the foundations for sustained economic growth

national_news.title: Reforming India's Tribunal System
bullets: The Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 aims to create a more independent, transparent, and professionally administered tribunal system.
A judiciary-led National Tribunals Commission will be set up to make selections to the tribunals and exercise oversight on their functioning.
The Bill seeks to reduce executive discretion while strengthening accountability in the tribunal system.

national_news.title: The New Era of Indian Agriculture and Allied Sectors
bullets: India's agriculture and allied sectors are witnessing a significant transformation, marked by rising productivity, stronger farmer support systems, and greater resilience.
Agriculture remains the backbone of India's economy, providing livelihoods to approximately 46.1 percent of the workforce.
Livestock and fisheries have maintained stable growth of 5-6 percent, strengthening rural incomes and supporting agricultural diversification.

national_news.title: BRICS nations need stronger frameworks to mobilise private capital at scale: Nirmala Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies need to build greater confidence, stability, predictability, and credible long-term frameworks to unlock sustained private capital flows at scale.
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the role of multilateral development banks in de-risking investments and mobilizing private capital.
The statement was made by Sitharaman on Wednesday, emphasizing the importance of stronger frameworks for BRICS nations to attract private capital.

national_news.title: Government of India Strengthens India's Health System for Affordable and Accessible Healthcare
bullets: The Government of India has strengthened India's health system over the past 12 years, making quality healthcare more accessible, affordable, and equitable.
Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) provides health insurance of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year.
The initiative aligns with the principle of 'Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, Sabka Vishwas and Sabka Prayas' to build an Atmanirbhar Bharat.

national_news.title: India Unveils Comprehensive National Counter Terrorism Policy & Strategy 'PRAHAAR'
bullets: PRAHAAR is India's first comprehensive National Counter Terrorism Policy & Strategy.
It provides a national counter-terrorism framework for prevention of, and responding to terrorist activities and radicalization.
The strategy is based on 'whole of government' and 'whole of society' approaches.

national_news.title: Vibrant Villages Programme-II approved by Central Government
bullets: The programme aims for comprehensive development of select villages in 46 blocks abutting the northern border.
Vibrant Villages Programme-II is a Central Sector Scheme with a total outlay of ₹6839 crores till the Financial Year 2028-29.
The programme was approved on 02nd April, 2025, for the comprehensive development of select villages in five states/UTs.

national_news.title: Vice-President flags off 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' in Delhi
bullets: Vice-President C P Radhakrishnan flagged off the 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' from Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The rally is part of the ongoing Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 campaign dedicated to the National Song Vande Mataram.
Union Cabinet Ministers and Ministers of State were also present at the event.

national_news.title: PIB Hyderabad workshop seeks to dispel myths around organ donation
bullets: PIB Hyderabad organised a Varta media workshop on organ donation to highlight common myths and medical facts.
Experts stressed the importance of donor families, public awareness, and voluntary pledges for organ donation.
NOTTO's Jug Jug Jiyo campaign aims to encourage organ donation.

national_news.title: NCSC to Review Union Government's Handling of Posts Reserved for Scheduled Caste Candidates
bullets: NCSC Chairperson Kishor Makwana has raised concerns over filling reserved posts with unreserved candidates.
The National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC) will review the Union government's handling of posts reserved for Scheduled Caste candidates.
This move aims to ensure that the rights of Scheduled Caste candidates are protected and their reserved posts are filled as per the law.

national_news.title: Assam is India's third-largest rubber-producing state
bullets: Assam ranks third in rubber production in India, after Kerala and Tripura.
India is a major producer and consumer of natural rubber.
Rubber is an elastic, flexible, and resilient material produced from the rubber tree.

national_news.title: Monsoon Session of Parliament Adjourns Sine Die; 12 Bills Passed by both Houses of Parliament
bullets: The Monsoon Session, 2026 of Parliament was adjourned sine die on Thursday, 13th August, 2026.
A total of 12 Bills were passed by both Houses of Parliament during the Session.
The Session provided 19 sittings spread over a period of 25 days.

national_news.title: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three Secures PIB Clearance
bullets: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three has secured clearance from the Public Investment Board (PIB).
This development is a significant step forward for the project's construction.
The project aims to improve the city's transportation infrastructure.

national_news.title: Cumulative Exports Estimated at US$ 316.42 Billion in April-July 2026-27
bullets: Cumulative exports (merchandise & services) grew by 13.16% to US$ 316.42 Billion in April-July 2026-27.
Merchandise exports registered a positive growth of 17.04% to US$ 173.78 Billion in April-July 2026-27.
Non-Petroleum exports increased by 12.79% to US$ 143.61 Billion in April-July 2026-27.

national_news.title: India and SACU Sign Terms of Reference for Preferential Trade Agreement
bullets: India and SACU signed Terms of Reference for negotiations towards a Preferential Trade Agreement.
Union Minister Shri Piyush Goyal called for a balanced and equitable India–SACU Trade Agreement.
Negotiations will cover eight important chapters, including trade in goods, market access for goods, and rules of origin.

national_news.title: PAC's Retrospective Examination of Defence Offsets Seems Odd
bullets: The Public Accounts Committee (PAC) has raised questions about the government's defence offset policy.
The policy is being quietly abandoned by the government, raising questions about parliamentary attention.
Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is at the center of the controversy.

national_news.title: India Building Capabilities in Semiconductor and AI Technologies
bullets: India is building capabilities in semiconductor design and fabrication to computing infrastructure and indigenous AI models.
Government initiatives are being taken across both semiconductor and AI technologies to recognize their convergence.
Semiconductors are the foundation of modern technology, powering everything from smartphones and vehicles to satellites and AI systems.

national_news.title: President Murmu presents Sangeet Natak Akademi fellowships, awards to over 100 artists
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards on eminent artists for 2024 and 2025.
The ceremony was held at Vigyan Bhawan in Delhi.
Over 100 artists received the fellowships and awards.

national_news.title: Organ donation gives new lease of life: Dr Sree Bhushan Raju
bullets: Dr Sree Bhushan Raju is promoting organ donation to give new lease of life to patients in need.
Organ donation is a noble cause that can save lives and improve the quality of life for many individuals.
The importance of organ donation is being highlighted to encourage more people to register as donors.

national_news.title: Stage set for 80th Independence Day Celebrations at Red Fort
bullets: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will lead the 80th Independence Day Celebrations from the Red Fort in Delhi on August 15, 2026.
The grand event is set to commemorate 150 years of the enduring national song 'Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'.
'Vande Mataram' will be rendered for the first time as part of the celebrations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inspects Proposed Medical College and Hospital Site in Gopalganj
bullets: Bihar CM inspected the proposed site for Maa Thawe Medical College and Hospital in Gopalganj.
He provided necessary directions for the project.
The CM also performed puja and prayers at the Thawe Temple for the state's prosperity and well-being.
